description: Classic Azure DevOps Release definition for Playwright/ReqnRoll/NUnit automation from the CI bin artifact (artifact name: testpackage, alias _FF_CI). Stages are independent/manual: Assembly Execution (DLLs + optional TestCategory filter), Test Suite Execution (test plan/suite/configuration), and Test Plan On-Demand Execution (uses $(test.RunId) with ManualTestRunId fallback). Independent execution modes, each with a distributed execution phase followed by one single-agent report collection phase for that deployment.

workflowTasks.name: Install .NET 8 SDK
Install Python 3.11 for consolidated reporting
Install latest stable Visual Studio Test Platform
Prepare and validate CI automation artifact

inputs.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$matches = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $env:SYSTEM_DEFAULTWORKINGDIRECTORY -Recurse -File -Filter 'Prepare-ReleaseTestPackage.ps1' | Where-Object { $_.Directory.Name -eq 'scripts' })
if ($matches.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Expected one packaged Prepare-ReleaseTestPackage.ps1. Run a new CI build with reporting dependencies and select that artifact.' }
& $matches[0].FullName

Publish this agent evidence for consolidation
